cards.example_en: That fantastic save kept our team in the match until the end.
cards.example_zh: 那次精彩的扑救让我们队一直撑到了比赛结束。

cards.example_en: The zoo is not far from our school.
cards.example_zh: 动物园离我们学校不远。

cards.example_en: We collected eggs and fed the goats on my cousin's farm.
cards.example_zh: 我们在表姐的农场捡了蛋，还喂了山羊。

cards.example_en: The farmer let our class pick strawberries if we left the small ones.
cards.example_zh: 农民让我们班摘草莓，但小的要留下。

cards.example_en: She is interested in fashion and design.
cards.example_zh: 她对时尚和设计感兴趣。

cards.example_en: A fast current pulled the little boat away from the bank.
cards.example_zh: 快速的水流把小船从岸边冲走了。

cards.example_en: The fat sparrow could barely reach the bird feeder.
cards.example_zh: 那只胖麻雀几乎飞不到喂鸟器上。

cards.example_en: My father cooked noodles for us after the football match.
cards.example_zh: 足球赛后，爸爸给我们煮了面条。

cards.example_en: What is your favourite subject?
cards.example_zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

cards.example_en: His fear of dogs kept him away from the park.
cards.example_zh: 他怕狗，所以一直远离那个公园。

cards.example_en: I feed the goldfish before I leave for school.
cards.example_zh: 我上学前会喂金鱼。

cards.example_en: I feel cold when the classroom windows stay open.
cards.example_zh: 教室窗户开着的时候，我觉得冷。

cards.example_en: A warm feeling spread through me when I saw Dad.
cards.example_zh: 见到爸爸时，一股温暖的感觉涌遍了全身。

cards.example_en: The town lantern festival lit the river for three nights.
cards.example_zh: 镇上的灯节把河面照亮了三个晚上。

cards.example_en: He stayed home because of a fever.
cards.example_zh: 他因为发烧待在家里。

cards.example_en: Only a few students stayed after class.
cards.example_zh: 只有少数学生课后留了下来。

cards.example_en: Cows were grazing in the field behind my uncle's farm.
cards.example_zh: 牛在我叔叔农场后面的田野里吃草。

cards.example_en: Those two boys should not fight in the hallway.
cards.example_zh: 那两个男孩不该在走廊里打架。

cards.example_en: Fill your bottle with water before the long hike.
cards.example_zh: 长途步行之前，把你的水瓶灌满水。

cards.example_en: Our class saw a film about ocean life on Friday night.
cards.example_zh: 我们班星期五晚上看了一部关于海洋生物的电影。

cards.example_en: The final whistle brought a huge cheer from the stands.
cards.example_zh: 终场哨声引来看台上巨大的欢呼。

cards.example_en: I often find my keys in this coat pocket.
cards.example_zh: 我经常在这件外套的口袋里找到钥匙。

cards.example_en: The weather stayed fine, so our picnic blankets remained outside.
cards.example_zh: 天气一直很好，所以我们的野餐垫就留在外面。

cards.example_en: I burned my finger while frying eggs this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早上煎鸡蛋时，我烫伤了手指。

cards.example_en: Finish your soup before it gets completely cold.
cards.example_zh: 趁汤还没彻底凉掉，把它喝完。

cards.example_en: Campers sat around a small fire after the sun set.
cards.example_zh: 露营的人日落后围坐在一小堆火旁边。

cards.example_en: The fireman carried the child to safety.
cards.example_zh: 消防员把孩子带到了安全的地方。

cards.example_en: A firework lit up the night sky.
cards.example_zh: 一朵烟花照亮了夜空。

cards.example_en: Mum steamed fish with ginger for dinner tonight.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈今晚用姜蒸了鱼当晚餐。

cards.example_en: These new shoes fit me after a week of walking.
cards.example_zh: 这双新鞋走了一个星期以后很合脚。

cards.example_en: Dad can fix the broken chair on Saturday morning.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸星期六早上能把那把坏椅子修好。

cards.example_en: Children raised the flag before class began today.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们今天在上课前升起了旗帜。

cards.example_en: The flat field behind the school is perfect for flying kites.
cards.example_zh: 学校后面那块平地非常适合放风筝。

cards.example_en: The flood covered the low bridge.
cards.example_zh: 洪水淹没了那座矮桥。

cards.example_en: Soup spilled across the kitchen floor during dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭时汤洒在了厨房的地板上。

cards.example_en: She picked a yellow flower from the pot by the window.
cards.example_zh: 她从窗边的花盆里摘了一朵黄花。

cards.example_en: Ben stayed in bed with flu for the whole weekend.
cards.example_zh: 本因为流感在床上躺了整整一个周末。

cards.example_en: Some birds fly across the sea when winter comes.
cards.example_zh: 冬天来的时候，有些鸟会飞过大海。

cards.example_en: Focus on your own paper during the maths exam.
cards.example_zh: 数学考试时要专心看自己的试卷。

cards.example_en: Thick fog covered the harbour when our ferry left.
cards.example_zh: 渡轮离开时，浓雾笼罩着港口。

cards.example_en: Village folk shared a big meal after the harvest.
cards.example_zh: 村里的人们在收获后一起吃了一顿丰盛的饭。

cards.example_en: Follow the blue signs to the city library.
cards.example_zh: 沿着蓝色指示牌走到市图书馆。

cards.example_en: Hot food was waiting when we came in from the rain.
cards.example_zh: 我们淋雨回来时，热饭已经摆好了。

cards.example_en: I felt like a fool when I forgot the ticket.
cards.example_zh: 忘了带票时我觉得自己像个傻瓜。

cards.example_en: I twisted my foot on the stairs at the stadium.
cards.example_zh: 我在体育场的楼梯上扭伤了脚。

cards.example_en: They kicked a football around the yard until sunset.
cards.example_zh: 他们在院子里踢足球，一直踢到日落。

cards.example_en: This gift is for my mum.
cards.example_zh: 这份礼物是给我妈妈的。

cards.example_en: The rescue force set up tents after the earthquake.
cards.example_zh: 救援部队在地震后搭起了帐篷。

cards.example_en: Foreign stamps fill the album my uncle gave me last year.
cards.example_zh: 外国邮票贴满了叔叔去年送我的集邮册。

cards.example_en: Pine trees fill the forest beyond the last bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 松树长满了末班车站那边的森林。

word.example_en: So far, we have learned forty words.
word.example_zh: 到目前为止，我们学了四十个词。

word.example_en: The village is far from the city.
We try to make guests feel at home.
word.example_zh: 我们尽量让客人感到自在。

word.example_en: I have a fever and need water.
A few students are still in the classroom.
Let us find out who left the note.
word.example_zh: 我们来查明是谁留的便条。

word.example_en: Call for help if the kitchen is on fire.
She runs in order to keep fit.
word.example_zh: 她跑步是为了保持健康。

word.example_en: It takes ten minutes on foot.
I like rice. As for noodles, I can eat a little.
word.example_zh: 我喜欢米饭。至于面条，我能吃一点。
